title: Describe provider overrides and ACP launch in configuration
statement: As a harness author or integration contributor, I can describe the setup needed by my harness so that Cordyceps can derive its provider override and selected launch mode from the definition instead of requiring consumers to implement harness-specific wiring.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The integration definition can express the configuration required to route the installed harness to the mock provider, including its supported environment or other configuration mechanism.
For an ACP-capable integration, the definition describes how to invoke the installed harness and any required installed adapter in ACP mode; Cordyceps derives the corresponding launch configuration.
When the definition cannot support the selected mode or required provider adapter, setup reports the unsupported combination rather than substituting a different interface.
